'''Pierce's black ops team''' was a team of black ops [[Imperial soldier]]s assembled by [[Pierce]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. They had the blessing of [[Arkos Rakton]], the supreme commander of the Military.

Fighting as a unit of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]], Pierce's black ops team participated in the [[Massacre at Haruun Kal]], [[Operation Force Crush]], and other battles. In [[3653 BBY]], around the time of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the unit was dissolved as a result of being unneeded--the war was going well enough that they were not needed in conflict.

In [[3640 BBY]], the squad was reorganized to fight in the [[Battle of Corellia]].<ref name="Storming the Bastion">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Lieutenant Pierce|Storming the Bastion}}</ref>
